entry.title: Advisory ACME-2026-08: Remote Code Execution in API Gateway
entry.summary: A critical vulnerability CVE-2026-88192 was identified in the API Gateway authentication filter. Attackers could bypass token verification by sending crafted HTTP headers.

entry.title: Advisory ACME-2026-09: Denial of Service in Session Store
entry.summary: Vulnerability CVE-2026-77180 allows unauthenticated attackers to cause memory exhaustion in Redis cluster nodes by transmitting malformed WebSocket frames.
